verdict.rationale: Formant's own marketing says users can "ask your fleet what's happening in plain language" and receive ML-driven task recommendations that people approve. Its analytics docs also mention an AI assistant for building dashboards. This is first-party natural-language querying and assistance, but there is no evidence that natural-language commands directly operate the product or robots; commands are documented as button clicks, events, or API calls. Missing for 10: documented natural-language command execution, depth on the AI assistant's scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask your fleet what's happening in plain language and get governed, ML-driven task recommendations — with people approving what happens next.
Using built-in visualizations, custom SQL queries, or our AI assistant, you can build a rich dashboard for your devices.
